summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K attaching a UK TR-1 major holdings notification, the non-US equivalent of a Schedule 13G/13D threshold disclosure. BlackRock, Inc. reported that on 14-Sep-2026 its aggregate holding crossed above the notifiable threshold, reaching 7.74% of voting rights: 7.19% attached to shares (179,210,221 votes), 0.08% via American Depositary Receipts and securities lending, and 0.47% through cash-settled CFDs. The prior notification showed 7.68%. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or transaction terms are stated; watch for further stake accumulation.
